p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2:
                continue
            points = set()
            for turns in range(4):
                rr, cc = r, c
                for _ in range(turns):
                    rr, cc = cc, w - 1 - rr
                points.add((rr, cc))
                points.add((rr, w - 1 - cc))
            values = [grid[rr][cc] for rr, cc in points if grid[rr][cc] != 2]
            out[r][c] = values[0]
    return out
''')
